# Dry County Restoration

> 24/7 restoration services in Corona, CA.

Dry County Restoration (Dry County Restoration) is a professional restoration contractor serving Corona, CA and surrounding areas since 2020. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (951) 667-9910 · Email: info@drycountyrestoration.com.
